property_summary: After a successful call to initialize(), it must revert on any subsequent call; the mutant allows a reentrant second call to succeed without revert, violating the invariant that initialized() is true and a second initialize() reverts.
change_summary: Move the `initialized = true;` assignment before the `if (initialized)` check so that reentrant calls will not revert on the second call if the first call completes normally.
